changelog.text: Enhanced Media3 player with scrubbing previews, subtitle sync, IPTV controls, and adaptive buffering.
Added Supabase-powered Watch Party with WebRTC calling, live chat, and synchronized playback.
Added IPTV/EPG support with XMLTV parsing, caching, and live program tracking.
Added new content providers, extractors, and progressive stream discovery.
Improved stream resolution, desktop playback, Cloudflare handling, and streaming compatibility.
Refreshed the UI with modern controls, provider branding, dynamic fonts, and responsive layouts.
Fixed desktop playback issues, WebRTC signaling, TV navigation, VoIP audio routing, and duplicate stream errors.
Improved download handling, search performance, EPG processing, and overall application stability.
